meta.name: skill-authoring-workflow
meta.description: Turn raw PM content into a compliant, publish-ready skill. Use when creating or updating a repo skill without breaking standards.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将原始产品内容转化为合规可发布的技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要创建或更新仓库中的技能且不违反标准。
copy.tagline_en: Turn raw PM content into a compliant, publish-ready skill.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create or update a repo skill without breaking standards.

howto.what: 将你的原始笔记、会议记录或零散提示整理成符合规范的技能文件（SKILL.md），并自动检查格式、元数据和引用，确保技能可以发布到仓库。
howto.when: 当你需要创建新技能或更新现有技能，并希望遵循仓库标准时触发。例如，你说“把这份研讨会笔记变成技能”或“更新现有技能”。

say.text: 把这份定价研讨会笔记变成一个交互式顾问技能。
say.note: 工作流会从笔记生成技能草稿。

say.text: 帮我更新现有的技能，不破坏仓库标准。
say.note: 工作流会检查并更新技能文件。

say.text: 用这个框架创建一个组件技能。
say.note: 工作流会引导你完成创建流程。

howto.what_en: Turns your raw notes, meeting transcripts, or half-baked prompt dumps into a compliant SKILL.md file, then validates structure, metadata, and cross-references so the skill is ready to publish in the repo.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to create a new skill or update an existing one while adhering to repo standards. For example, when you say 'turn these workshop notes into a skill' or 'update an existing skill'.

say_en.text: Turn these pricing workshop notes into an interactive advisor skill.
say_en.note: The workflow generates a draft from the notes.

say_en.text: Update my existing skill without breaking repo standards.
say_en.note: The workflow checks and updates the skill file.

say_en.text: Create a component skill from this framework.
say_en.note: The workflow guides you through creation.
